variants.headline: A company goes under
variants.body: A company has gone under in {colony}. Labour finds the stewardship of {target} wanting; ordinary people deserve a more responsible standard of conduct.

variants.headline: Business failure enters the colony's record
variants.body: The colony has seen a company fail. Labour finds the stewardship of {target} wanting; ordinary people deserve a more responsible standard of conduct.

variants.headline: An enterprise reaches failure
variants.body: A business in the colony has gone under. Labour finds the stewardship of {target} wanting; ordinary people deserve a more responsible standard of conduct.
